findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a source tree of the compilation, including diagnostics with Location.None. Previously, location-less diagnostics were reported (e.g. MemberNeedsKey with a null location, or other diagnostics created with null locations from GetIdentifierLocation/GetLocation helpers). This is a compile-time diagnostic filter. It is not a MessagePackSecurity setting and does not touch depth limits, UntrustedData, or comparers, so its security impact is limited. It could silently suppress MsgPack diagnostics that guard against insecure or unsupported configurations if their location is null in source types (for example when the helper returns null for a partial or generated declaration).

receipt_plan.detail: Add an analyzer test where a source-declared [MessagePackObject] type triggers a diagnostic whose location helper returns null, and assert the diagnostic is still reported; compare diagnostics from base build vs head build.
